description: Measurement profile for one country: data freshness (last measurement and band), measurement volume and the blocking-signal technique mix. Its nationally blocked domain list is under review (the national blocklist layer let false positives through in open countries and is being rebuilt with a stricter rule), so that field is null and a review object gives the layer's window end as the data date.

country_code.description: ISO 3166-1 alpha-2 code (e.g., IR, CN, RU)

name: get_country_profile
